title: Ogya Kronkron Ɔkra a Ɔde Ne Ho Ama
intro: Akokoduru soronko ho asɛm bi da w’anim, faako a ankorankoro biako nyaa akokoduru kasa tiaa anibuei mũ bi gyidi ahorow a agye ntini sen biara no. Di saa nsɛm a ɛyɛ sereserew a efi tete no akyi, na wubehu asetra a gyidi a enhinhim, anwonwakwan so nkwagye, ne fapem a wɔto a anka ɛbɛkyerɛ ɔpepepem pii honhom mu akwantu no ahyɛ no agyirae. Trace clue biara yiye — ogya kronkron no da so ara kae.
clues: Wɔwoo me wɔ ofie bi a na wobu ɔsoro abɔde na wodi abosom, nanso biribi a ɛwɔ me mu tɔnn pow nea wɔsom no.
Migyinaa m’asase sodifo a ɔwɔ tumi sen biara no anim, na mebubuu abosom ankasa a me nkurɔfo kotow ma no no, na mekae sɛ ɔsoro Bɔfo no nkutoo na ɔfata ahofama.
Wɔhyɛɛ ogya a ɛredɛw wɔ me din mu, nanso mebɔɔ ​​dawuru sɛ Nea mesom no no nkutoo na obegye me nkwa — na wɔhyɛɛ ogyaframa no sɛ ɛnyɛ nwini na ahobammɔ wom.
Migyaw biribiara a minim no wɔ ɔsoro ahyɛde bi so, na me ne m’abusua kyinkyin nkoko a ɛso yɛ kusuu mu, na mede me ho too nsiesiei bi a minnya nhui so.
Bere a yegyinaa m’abakan nkyɛn wɔ bon bi a ɛso yɛ kwa mu no, yɛboom maa ofie kronkron bi fapem so, kronkronbea a wɔahyɛ sɛ wɔn a wɔbrɛ wɔn ho ase nyinaa.
Wonim me sɛ Khalilullah — Mmɔborohunufoɔ Panyin no adamfo paa — na me din bɛyɛɛ nea ɛne gyidie a ɛfa ahofama ne ahobrɛaseɛ ho no wɔ abusuabɔ daa.

arabic: إِنِّى وَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِىَ لِلَّذِى فَطَرَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ حَنِيفًۭا ۖ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
verse: Indeed, I have turned my face [i.e., self] toward He who created the heavens and the earth, inclining toward truth, and I am not of those who associate others with Allāh." (6:79)
